0.6.2 is a drop-in patch for 0.6.x: format epoch 2 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot or Raft protocol change. Upgrade from 0.6.0 or 0.6.1 in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`); no fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Fixed:** a memory-WAL node restarted alone (one node of three) heals itself: it no longer initializes its groups again, and the leaders rebuild it (remove, re-add as a learner, promote once caught up) with no operator.
- **Fixed:** an empty memory-WAL replica never votes before it has caught up, so it cannot help elect a leader that lacks entries committed with its lost copy.
- **Fixed:** a majority of a memory-WAL group restarted at once stops the group instead of losing writes: no leader is elected from the incomplete logs and writes are refused until an operator adopts a survivor's log with `POST /__ursula/raft/{group}/rejoin/adopt-survivor/{node}` on every node of the group.
- **Fixed:** `ursulactl repair-restarted-voter` accepts a group the leader already rebuilt.

Production clusters must still use the disk WAL. Details are in the [0.6.2 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#062); memory-WAL restarts are described in [Restarting a memory-WAL node](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/operations#restarting-a-memory-wal-node).
